<div class="card-body">
'''Sunsdown''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">日没</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">惑星の星系カードに配備し、同一星系の位置カードを“夜間状態”にする。それらの場所での戦闘では、双方の側が運命数を１回しか加えられなくなる。“夜間状態”の位置には、コストなしでスパイを配備できる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-230o-Face.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">タトゥイーンの二つの太陽が沈む時、サンド・ピープルや、その他の脅威が迫り、戦いはより危険を増す。またホスでは、気温が極限まで低下する。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Sunset.

'''Card text:''' Deploy on a planet system. Locations in that system become nighttime. In battles there, each side may add only one destiny draw. Spies may deploy at nighttime locations at no cost.

'''Lore:''' When Tatooine's two suns set, Sand People and other threats close in and battle becomes more dangerous. On Hoth, the temperature drops to extremes.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Sunsdown]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 97. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
